annotations.title: DEFAULT: Complete a task with ATL

description: DEFAULT FIRST-USE TOOL. Give ATL the user's natural-language task. ATL builds a structured task specification, selects a task-compatible eligible provider/tool, executes it, applies bounded fallback when appropriate, verifies that the returned result actually matches the requested task constraints, records task-level learning, and returns the result. ATL can route search, extract, summarize, translate, and classify when verified supply is available. Use atl_decide only when the caller explicitly wants routing/decision information without ATL-owned execution.

required_capability.description: Optional capability hint. Omit unless the caller already knows the required capability; ATL normally derives a structured TaskSpec from the task.

task.description: The natural-language task to complete. Include the goal and any relevant input, constraints, or desired output.

name: atl_complete_task

capability.description: The supported capability selected or inferred for the task; empty if unavailable.

decision.description: ATL Decision evidence retained for advanced/debug consumers.

discovery_resume_status.description: Outcome of the same-call discovery resume attempt when used.

discovery_resume_used.description: True when ATL synchronously ran bounded discovery/promotion and retried the same task.

execution.description: ATL execution evidence retained for advanced/debug consumers; null when execution did not start.

execution_status.description: Provider execution status; EXECUTED alone does not imply task correctness.

fallback_used.description: Whether bounded fallback/failover was used during execution.

ok.description: True only when execution succeeded and ATL's task-level result verifier accepted the result.

result.description: The provider's task result. When ok=false, inspect result_validation before trusting it.

result_validation.description: ATL task-level correctness checks. passed must be true before the result is treated as product success.

stage.description: The furthest ATL product stage reached for this call.
